claim: A reusable, topology-only schematic of a six-clone tumor tree for the fixed K=6 model setting.

semantic_contract.unique_claim: K=6 fixes the number of clone nodes for a run; this component shows only one legal rooted topology and does not encode local fractions or posterior support.
semantic_contract.reading_order: Read the K=6 title, then the rooted topology from C1 through C6, then the topology-only note.
semantic_contract.visual_encoding: Dark blue lines encode parent-descendant relations. Orange circular marks identify clone nodes. Node count encodes K=6; equal node size is categorical and does not encode fraction. The light-blue canvas matches the model-rules panel so the reusable nested SVG has no white block.
semantic_contract.quantitative_claims: Exactly six clone-node marks are displayed, so K=6. The tree has one tumor founder C1, three direct descendants C2-C4, and two second-level descendants C5-C6. No η or φ values are asserted.
semantic_contract.topology_rule: C1 is the single founder; C1 parents C2, C3, and C4; C2 parents C5; C4 parents C6. Edge length is schematic and has no time or fraction scale. The C3 label is placed below its node, between tree levels, to keep it clear of the central branch.
semantic_contract.overlap_policy: Tree edges intentionally meet clone-node marks as structural connections. Clone labels sit outside the visible orange marks.

asset_inventory.dimensions: 83×93 PNG, transparent background, visible orange glyph retained
asset_inventory.reuse: six times with preserved aspect ratio; node size is categorical only
